camera.convention: tf imu_link->frame is T_imu_cam = T_imu_velo * inv(T_cam_velo); T_cam_velo = [I|baseline] * R_rect_00 * [R|T] of calib_velo_to_cam.txt

frames.base_link: defined as the OXTS/IMU frame (KITTI convention; no separate vehicle frame is published). base_link -> imu_link is the identity.
frames.imu_link: OXTS unit; x forward, y left, z up (KITTI IMU/GPS frame)
frames.odom: ENU-like local frame of the OXTS trajectory: Mercator projection of the first packet's latitude, origin at the first packet of each drive (kitti_oxts_pose_world_imu)
frames.velo_link: Velodyne HDL-64E; tf imu_link -> velo_link is the inverse of calib_imu_to_velo.txt

source.input_digest_scope: per drive: calib_imu_to_velo.txt, OXTS and Velodyne timestamps, every OXTS packet and every Velodyne sweep (calibrex.data.kitti_ins_lidar); the combined digest hashes the per-drive digests in time order

topics./camera/camera_info: CameraInfo cam2_optical: pinhole K from P_rect, no distortion (the images are rectified); one per image
topics./camera/image_raw: Image cam2_optical: rectified 8-bit luminance (mono8) of image_02, stamped with the camera's timestamps.txt
topics./oxts/fix: NavSatFix imu_link: OXTS lat/lon/alt; the GNSS position solution is taken at the OXTS unit (antenna lever arm not published)
topics./oxts/imu: Imu imu_link: OXTS body-frame wx wy wz and ax ay az; no orientation
topics./oxts/odometry: Odometry odom->imu_link: INS pose; twist = body-frame velocity and angular rate (OXTS vf,vl,vu / wf,wl,wu rotated from the level frame by roll, pitch)
topics./oxts/twist: TwistStamped base_link: the same body-frame velocity and rate as a wheel-odometry proxy (KITTI has no wheel odometry); declare with --topic-kind /oxts/twist=wheel
topics./tf_static: TFMessage transient-local: base_link->imu_link (identity), imu_link->velo_link (T_imu_velo), imu_link->cam2_optical (T_imu_velo composed with the inverse of the vendor Velodyne-to-rectified-camera transform)
topics./velodyne_points: PointCloud2 velo_link: x y z intensity time (float32); time is each point's offset (s) from the header stamp, modelled from its azimuth: -atan2(y, x) / (2 pi) * (t_end - t_start) of its sweep (velodyne_points timestamps_start.txt and timestamps_end.txt)
